subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Out of every hospital in Maryland on Medicare's list, every kind counted.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Sibley Memorial Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks fourth of 6 Johns Hopkins Health System hospitals; The Johns Hopkins Hospital has the most, 9,939. About 8.4 for every bed.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Johns Hopkins Health System run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: Maryland 4, the District of Columbia 1 and Florida 1. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: In how many states does Johns Hopkins Health System run a hospital, by the federal list?
questions.why: Florida, Maryland and the District of Columbia.

questions.q: How many Johns Hopkins Health System hospitals are in Maryland, by the federal list?
questions.why: That is 4 of the 56 hospitals in Maryland on CMS's list.

questions.why: That is 1 of the 10 hospitals in the District of Columbia on CMS's list.

questions.q: How many Johns Hopkins Health System hospitals are in Florida, by the federal list?
questions.why: That is 1 of the 221 hospitals in Florida on CMS's list.

questions.q: What percent of the hospitals in Maryland belong to Johns Hopkins Health System?
questions.why: 4 of 56. The next biggest system there, University of Maryland Medical System, has 11.
